title: Implementation
intro: Fill one TODO in the overdue helper so the failing test passes.
taskPanel:
Make the overdue badge rule work in web/src/lib/overdue.ts.

isOverdue(task, today) has one TODO line. Replace it with the rule: a task is overdue when its due date is before today. A task due today is not overdue. Keep the rest of the file as it is.

Run the tests first: the one test in web/src/lib/overdue.test.ts fails. Run them again after your change. When you submit, hidden tests check the same rule on more cases.

Page preview shows three sample tasks drawn by your helper. Its two page files are supplied and locked.
objectives: Keep the no-due-date check as it is

criteria.title: Hidden tests
criteria.description: The hidden tests check the rule on more dates.

criteria.title: Visible test
criteria.description: The test you can see passes.

criteria.title: Code quality
criteria.description: No TODO left, and the helper stays short.

criteria.title: Process
criteria.description: You ran the tests before submitting.

hints: Two ISO dates compare as text. Which comparison leaves a task due today out?
